summary: Olin Corp filed an 8-K disclosing litigation related to its planned merger of equals with Huntsman Corporation, announced June 15, 2026. Two Huntsman stockholder complaints in New York Supreme Court allege deficiencies in the joint proxy statement/prospectus regarding the merger. The transaction structure is a merger of equals via a direct merger or subsidiary merger, with Olin as the acquirer. Shareholder meetings are set for August 25, 2026. The filing updates on pending litigation but provides no deal terms or pricing. Watch for potential supplemental disclosures or injunction proceedings before the vote; risk-arb angle centers on litigation resolution and shareholder approval.
